name: Oakhaven Town Square
description: The bustling center of Oakhaven Hamlet. Captain Vaelen stands here near the Daily Quest Board, directing newcomers and organizing defenses.
visualTheme: A vibrant cobblestone plaza centered around a large mossy fountain, with colorful merchant tents and a tall wooden quest board.

history.createdWhy: Built as the town center when Oakhaven was officially incorporated.
history.builtWho: Constructed by the initial Silverbrook pioneer guilds.
history.majorEvents: Hosted the treaty negotiations with local wood-sprite emissaries.
history.whyExists: Acts as the social, political, and defensive heart of the foothills region.
history.currentConflicts: Caravans arriving from the hills report goblin scouts observing the plaza from the cliffs.

ecosystem.weather: Warm and sunny with a light breeze

npcs.name: Guard Captain Vaelen
dialogue: Eyes sharp, novice. The Oakhaven guards can't protect everyone.
If you want to survive outside these gates, you'd better learn to swing that sword.
The road east to the Whispering Canopy is closed until we deal with the goblin threat.
